title: ESMA Retail Leverage Cap Enforcement (1:30 Limit)
precondition: Retail investor under European ESMA regulation joins MAM group.
expected: Sizing engine enforces 1:30 maximum leverage limit for ESMA client child tickets; reduces lot size to comply.
coverage_note: Requires compliance policy fixtures, jurisdiction controls, document/audit access and authorized evidence. Trading API success cannot establish compliance.
